title: Figure 2.5: Landmine Detection Scheme Using a Hybrid Magnetron IEC Neutron Source
description: Presentation slide titled 'How to Detect Landmine' stating 'Neutron yield of ~10^8 is required'. A diagram shows a neutron source above ground, a gamma-ray detector and neutron detector, with arrows for thermal neutrons, captured gamma rays and back-scattered neutrons interacting with a buried 'landmine (explosive)'. A small photo shows landmine samples, alongside a table of the atomic ratio of TNT explosive (H 3, C 7, N 3, O 6) and notes on H(n,γ) 2.22 MeV and N(n,γ) 10.83 MeV gamma-ray emission.
